content: Standard synergy stage-gate: Gate 1 = high-level idea (low confidence), progressing through increasing feasibility/ROI validation, to Gate 3 = fully vetted, credible, approved for implementation (i.e. idea -> validated -> committed -> captured maps to this gate progression). A synergy register enforces invariants (net benefit <= gross benefit - cost to achieve) and auto-recalculates confidence as drivers change; entries route through an approval workflow with SLA/overdue flags. Devensoft/Midaxo both market 'confidence' or 'stage' fields plus cost-to-achieve tracking as core synergy-module features.
